progress.create.fallback: Render a visible Markdown task list in the current conversation.

progress.update.fallback: Update the visible Markdown task list in the current conversation.

context.pass.fallback: Build a validated portable handoff with required fields and stable artifact or evidence references.

user.choose.fallback: Render stable numbered Markdown choices and accept a written reply.

user.approve.fallback: Render one numbered approval gate and accept a written reply.

agent.dispatch.fallback: Execute the unit sequentially in the parent or report that delegation is unavailable.

agent.resume.fallback: Return the scoped finding to the parent for sequential repair.

agent.interrupt.fallback: Stop new dispatch, report in-flight work honestly, and continue best effort.

visual.present.fallback: Use the static visual composer when available, otherwise numbered Markdown.

visual.session.start.fallback: Present the standalone static visual artifact, otherwise numbered Markdown, and keep the decision in the conversation.

visual.session.publish.fallback: Render the screen through the static visual composer, otherwise numbered Markdown.

visual.session.read.fallback: Ask the user to reply in the conversation and treat the reply as supporting feedback.

visual.session.stop.fallback: Report that no live companion session is running and continue in the conversation.

workspace.isolate.fallback: Use a validated Git worktree fallback or run sequentially when isolation is unsafe.

web.fetch.fallback: Use supplied local evidence or report that current web evidence is unavailable.

artifact.read.fallback: Use the runtime's bounded repository read surface.

artifact.write.fallback: Report the intended patch without claiming that files changed.

verification.run.fallback: Report the exact unrun command and why execution is unavailable.
